about: CHAT_PLAN Phase 4's loose-ends fixture (Brief 13's done-when): seventy notes, eight planted loose ends.
A loose end is unfinished by its own words (need to, waiting on, must, chase up, follow up, todo, should).
Ten finished items say the same kind of thing in the past tense, so a model matching on topic alone is caught.
Each planted note carries an anchor word an answer naming it will use. Built by a script, not by hand.

notes.content: Paid the council tax for the year, receipt filed.
Finished the quarterly report and sent it to the team.
Booked the train to Edinburgh, seat 42 in coach C.
Need to ring the landlord back about the boiler, he left a voicemail on Tuesday.
Returned the faulty kettle, the shop gave a full refund on the spot.
Called mum on Sunday, she is well and the garden is thriving.
Renewed the passport, it arrived in eight days.
Sorted the recycling rota with the flat next door.
Replaced the bathroom light bulb with a warm white one.
Submitted the expenses for the Leeds trip.
Waiting on the refund from the airline for the cancelled Porto flight.
Cleaned out the gutters, they were full of leaves.
Sourdough: 50g rye, 50g water, feed twice a day.
The oven runs hot, bake at 230C with the lid on.
Favourite walk: along the canal to the lock and back, about 5km.
Book quote: the best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago.
Wifi password for the cabin is pinecone77.
Must renew the car insurance before the 14th, the quote is in my email.
Bike tyre pressure 60 psi front, 65 psi rear.
The cat likes the salmon pouches, not the chicken ones.
Notes from the pottery class: centre the clay before opening it.
Coffee ratio 1:16, grind medium fine for the pour over.
Birthday ideas for Sam: a good pen, climbing chalk, a map print.
Recipe: lentil soup with cumin, carrots and a squeeze of lemon.
Chase up the invoice from the plumber, he still has not sent it.
The lake was freezing but the swim was worth it.
Podcast worth hearing: the episode on medieval bridges.
Garden: the tomatoes ripened late this year, the basil bolted.
Running log: 10k in 54 minutes, legs felt heavy.
Quote from the meeting: ship small, ship often.
Film night list: Paterson, The Station Agent, Columbus.
Follow up with Priya about the conference talk slides, she wanted a draft.
Allotment plot number is 14, the gate code is 2580.
The bakery on Elm Street does the best cardamom buns.
Train times: the 7:42 is usually on time, the 8:10 never is.
Bread flour is cheaper at the market than the supermarket.
Camping kit lives in the loft, left side behind the suitcases.
The old laptop battery lasts about two hours now.
Todo: return the library books, two weeks overdue now.
Pancake recipe: one cup flour, one egg, one cup milk.
Bird spotted in the garden: a goldcrest, tiny and quick.
Holiday memory: the ferry to Mull in the rain, dolphins at the bow.
Recommended by Jo: the noodle place behind the station.
Paint colour for the hallway is Farrow and Ball Skimming Stone.
Bus 21 goes to the hospital, bus 9 to the university.
Should book the dentist check-up, it has been over a year.
The tea shop closes at four on Saturdays.
Guitar: learned the F barre chord at last.
Stargazing: Jupiter was bright in the east around ten.
Hiking boots size 44, the wide fit.
Plants: water the fern weekly, the cactus monthly.
Library card number 2299 1834.
Need to fix the squeaky back gate hinge before the neighbours complain again.
Swimming pool lane times: 7 to 9 weekday mornings.
Saw the Hockney exhibition, the iPad drawings were the best room.
The neighbour's dog is called Biscuit.
Recipe: overnight oats with grated apple and cinnamon.
Cinema membership renews automatically in March.
Our anniversary dinner was at the little Greek place.
Chess: the Italian game, bishop to c4 on move three.
Rain gauge read 18mm overnight.
Spare keys are with Ana at number 12.
Notes on sleep: no screens after ten helped.
The museum is free on the first Sunday of the month.
Strawberry jam: equal weights fruit and sugar, a lemon.
Postcode for the new office is LS1 4AP.
The fish shop on the quay sells the best mackerel.
Yoga: hold the pigeon pose for a minute each side.
Car oil type 5W-30, check it monthly.
Moon landing documentary was excellent.
